ValidationRule.description: This validation rule will prevent unauthorized users from completing the Reg B letter task.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: Subject = 'Create and Send Reg B Letter' && ($UserRole.Name != 'Sales Operations' || $UserRole.Name != 'Executive/CEO') && ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Complete')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This is a compliance task and must be completed by an Operations user. If you are not sending a Regulation B Letter to this customer, please DO NOT CLOSE THIS TASK.
